DISCOVER OUR TWO CAMPUSES
Vauban Campus (for Business, Economics, Finance
and Life Sciences programs)
Boulevard Vauban, Lille
The Vauban campus is ideally located in the heart of
Lille’s student quarter, right in front of the library. On
the picture below, you can see the new Michel Falise
building of FGES, located at 13 rue de Toul.
Located in a pole of excellence for innovation in
digital sciences, the WeNov campus provides our
students with a unique opportunity to study in a
highly professionalizing environment.
If students have classes on both campuses, they can
move from one campus to another by using public
transportation (bus or metro: 15-20 min), bikes (10
min), or by walking (30 min).
WeNov Campus (for Digital Sciences programs)
Euratechnologies district, Lille

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
If your students have any concerns or questions, we encourage you to share our FAQ with them. It covers the most relevant topics,
including the steps following their nomination, accomodation, the registration process, and more. The content is organized by
subject to ensure students can easily find the answers they need.
